### The Shaky Rock
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-4-2024.html
Passage: John 21:15
Points:
- Peter carried deep shame over denying Christ, likely questioning his place among the disciples.
- Jesus addressed him as "Simon" to confront his shakiness before rebuilding him into a rock.
- Christ prioritizes our devotion above all else, since genuine love for Him is indispensable.
- Jesus graciously restored Peter and entrusted him with the responsibility of feeding His lambs.
- God offers grace and second chances, empowering flawed believers to serve through His strength.

### Choosing Calling Over Comfort
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-20-2020.html
Passage: John 21:15
Points:
- After the crucifixion, Peter retreated to the safety and familiarity of his former fishing occupation.
- Jesus asked Peter if he loved Him more than the comfortable life he knew.
- The Lord called Peter to shift from a calculating fisherman to an attentive, loving shepherd.
- Believers face their own attachments and comforts that can pull them away from God's purpose.
- God empowers believers through the Holy Spirit to leave fear behind and step into their calling.
